#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The same clean run without Docker: a fresh copy of the committed project under /tmp.
set -euo pipefail
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'cd /; chmod -R u+w "$dir"; command rm -rf "$dir"' EXIT
git -C "$root" archive --format=tar HEAD | tar -x -C "$dir"
cd "$dir" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null && npm test
description: Test script that runs committed project tests in a throwaway container: archives HEAD, runs npm ci and npm test, then deletes container.

Directory: cd to git root using rev-parse.
Pipeline: git archive HEAD piped to docker run with node:22-bookworm, which extracts, installs, tests.
